title: Boeing KC-46A Everett production line: 105th KC-46A Delivery
summary: Air Mobility Command recorded the 105th KC-46A delivery from Everett. Phase 56E entity use: Cumulative delivery milestones are published with the separate fielded-aircraft, sustaining-rate, and deficiency denominators attached.
key_findings: The later milestone supplies a second cumulative observation for the same line and product.
Entity layer: Everett KC-46A production and delivery center.
Compatibility boundary: Same product and line; fielded, delivered, planned rate, and deficiency status remain separate.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: Two cumulative milestones do not isolate sustained production rate, accepted capability, cost, quality, or causation.
Government milestone records plus independent GAO program review.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
